parameters.donor_weight: equal per unique evaluation pose, pooled across same-anchor other routes
parameters.initialization: zero mean independent latent states, first estimated range for initial variance
parameters.propagation: literal D7 local Q; previous posterior range, odometric |ds| and bias-corrected gyro yaw increment
parameters.limits: 0.04 m moving packet spacing; 5 deg yaw grid except 4.76 deg R4; white variance folded into R
parameters.plus_K: W5 s second moment unless upper, where corresponding donor second moment is used; no duplicate consider state

bootstrap: seed and site resampled within case; common draws paired across arms and bias signs
